description: Labels for distractor materials. These must NOT appear in the final video timeline.

distractors.label: duplicate_distractor
distractors.reason: This is a truncated copy of source_001. Using it indicates the agent did not perform real content selection.

distractors.label: blurred_distractor
distractors.reason: This is a blurred version of source_003. It should not appear in a quality edit.

distractors.label: low_bitrate_distractor
distractors.reason: This is a severely compressed version of source_004. Its quality is too low for a professional edit.

distractors.label: irrelevant_distractor
distractors.reason: This is a reversed (time-reversed) version of source_005. Its content is semantically backward.

verification_method: Check timeline.json source_ref.media_id fields against distractor asset_ids. If any distractor appears, L1 check 'distractor_excluded' fails.
